name: premise-codex
description: PREMiSE workflow guidance and minimal coherence tools for Codex agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep agent actions grounded in fresh evidence.
interface.longDescription: PREMiSE teaches agents to record source versions, revalidate mutable evidence, and guard consequential actions without pretending to be a database or truth oracle.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PREMiSE to keep mutable evidence fresh before a guarded action.
